---
title: Spaghetti with Tuna
id: MAR-0114
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g spaghetti
- 200 g tuna
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 1 onion
- 1 tablespoon pine nuts
- 20 g basil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the onion and dice it.
2. Cut the tuna into 2 cm cubes and brown in a pan with half the oil for a minute, then lower the heat, remove the tuna draining it, add the onion and pine nuts to the pan and let it wilt for 7-8 minutes.
3. Add the tuna to the onion and salt lightly.
4. Cook the pasta, drain it, pour it into the pan and mix with the remaining oil; distribute on plates and finish with the snipped basil leaves.
